exposure: local injection of methotrexate under ultrasound guidance
outcome: successful treatment of cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
cohort: 17 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
finding: Suction curettage, alone or combined with local intrinsic methotrexate injection, was used to successfully treat cesarean scar ectopic pregnancies, though some patients experienced severe bleeding requiring interventions like intrauterine balloon insertion or blood transfusion.
